bio.text: Jennifer Fidler, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 94 since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
She was born in Mobile, Alabama, and earned a degree in ornamental horticulture from Auburn University in 1992 and a master's degree in education from Troy State University in 2001.
Her career experience includes founding Fidler Consulting and working as public works director for the City of Fairhope; she also served on the Fairhope Planning Commission.
